name: carscore
description: CarScore V2 — first-car buying copilot for Canada: scrapes listings, scores them on reliability, value, winter capability and ownership cost, and ranks the best-value cars.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
